findings.finding_summary: Left axillary lymph node core biopsy showing metastatic carcinoma, grade 3. Immunohistochemistry (TTF-1 diffusely strongly positive, GATA-3 and progesterone receptor negative, oestrogen receptor weak nuclear positivity) indicates a lung primary rather than the initially favoured breast origin. Additional molecular/biomarker testing performed on the tumour.

report_summary: Core biopsy of an enlarging left axillary lymph node shows metastatic carcinoma, grade 3. Initial impression favoured breast primary, but subsequent immunohistochemistry (TTF-1 diffusely strongly positive; GATA-3 and progesterone receptor negative; oestrogen receptor weak) indicated a lung primary. PD-L1 testing was strongly positive on two occasions with different assays (100% with Dako pharmDx 22C3, corrected by amendment from an initial clerical mislabelling as 22CS; 80% with Ventana SP263). Molecular testing showed no targetable variants in EGFR, KRAS, NRAS or BRAF, and ALK and ROS1 were negative.
